exchanges: ugh coffee is not doing its job yet this morning
Hang in there, the second cup usually helps.
so i finally started at the Larchmont nursery, my hands are covered in dirt lol
Congrats on the new job, getting your hands dirty sounds kind of fun.
its pouring here, the gutters are basically waterfalls
Sounds like a good day to stay in and keep dry.
my sister just signed a lease in Penhallow, not too far from me
Nice, close enough for easy visits.
my cat mortimer just knocked a plant off the shelf and stared at me like it was my fault
Classic cat move, he clearly has no regrets.
thinking soup tonight, maybe something with lentils
Lentil soup is perfect for this weather.
dee, my brothers wife, finally bought a house out in Corrigan
That's a big step, good for her.
going to ruthie's birthday thing on the weekend, need to find a gift
Fun, I'm sure you'll find something she'll love.
been practicing euphonium again, the neighbours must love me haha
Ha, at least they're getting free concerts.
the vet said its normal for a ragdoll to shed this much, so thats a relief
Good news, nothing to worry about then.
finally cleaned out the fridge, found some scary stuff in the back
Brave work, a fresh fridge feels great.
my brother threw his back out, doc says its sciatica
Ouch, I hope he takes it easy and feels better soon.
kinda tired today, might sneak in a nap
A nap sounds well earned.
started Middlemarch last night, slow going but i like it
It rewards patience, so it's worth sticking with.
ruthie wants to grab lunch soon, havent seen her in ages
Catching up sounds really nice.
my coworker Halvard brought cinnamon buns in today, absolute legend
That's the kind of coworker everyone needs.
my umbrella finally died, flipped inside out in the wind
Might be time for a sturdier one.
my sister still drives that ancient Saab, it makes the weirdest noises
Old cars really do have personality.
kinda proud of myself for meal prepping this week
Nice work, future you will be grateful.
dee is obsessed with curling now, shes at the rink every night
Sounds like she's found her thing.
the cat is asleep on my laptop again, guess im not working
He's clearly claiming it as his.
tomorrows gonna be long, we have a huge plant delivery coming
Hope it all goes smoothly.
we tried this new spot called Saffronia for dinner, i think its my new favourite
Love finding a new go-to place.
ok im heading to bed, night
Good night, sleep well.
